calls.video_title: Do Food Delivery Robots Make DoorDash Stock a No-Brainer Buy? | DASH Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: DCF says fairly valued ($185 vs $183) at forward PE 23.8; delivery-robot rollout promising but risk/reward not yet enough for an upgrade after -13% last month.
calls.base_case: Fair value $185, within margin of safety.
calls.bull_case: Autonomous delivery scales and drives margin expansion; consumer willingness to pay for convenience keeps growing.
calls.bear_case: Valuation leaves no margin of safety; robot rollout could prove capital-intensive.
